anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.
pass_a_gloss: For the sheep was sacrificed on the fourteenth of the month in the midst of the evenings, when, the fifteenth beginning, the circle of the moon becomes most full, as it seems to those about these things.
pass_b_english: For the sheep was sacrificed on the fourteenth of the month in the midst of the evenings, when, as the fifteenth begins, the circle of the moon becomes most full, as those who study these things hold (Exodus 12:6).
source_text: Ἐθύετο γὰρ] τὸ πρόβατον τῇ [τεσσαρεσκαι]δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς [ἀνὰ μέ]σον τῶν ἑσπερινῶν, [ὅτε, ἀρ]χομένης πεντεκαιδ[εκά]της, πληρέστατος ὁ τ[ῆς σε]λήνης κύκλος γίνετ[αι|| [ὡς τοῖς περὶ ταῦτα δοκεῖ.
